label: exploratory
description: Pre-disturbance burn-in scan over the 18 planned EXP-002 cells, all 3 arms, 3 seeds (301-303, disjoint from EXP-002 seeds). T = t_d = 500, no shock and no post window, so no primary-outcome contrast is computed. Purpose: find degenerate cells (no order before the shock) and measure per-cell runtime before the freeze. Exploratory.
